critique: The screen clearly fulfills the SkiFree title/start brief: the SkiFree name, concise control instructions, a large Start action, readable top HUD, snowy mountain/slope preview, skier, gates, and trees are all visibly present in a committed pixel-game frame. The central modal-like title card, however, covers much of the slope and makes the skier gameplay glimpse feel secondary and compressed; it reads partly as a generic overlay on a scene rather than the game world being the primary promise. The tiny face-like square near the bottom is unexplained and may be mistaken for another required game object.
suggestion: Retain the full title, controls, Start action, HUD, skier, gates, and trees, but reduce or lift the title card so more of the downhill route is visibly traceable behind it. Clarify the skier's direction and relationship to the gates, and either label the small bottom icon as a relevant HUD element or remove it if it has no game role. Ensure the screen continues to read as a ready-to-start skiing run rather than an abstract title card with incidental scenery.
